// INSTRUCTIONS: Copy this to your project as .claude/settings.json. Uncomment the hooks you want to use. Delete these comment lines.
// MINIMUM: Start with just Stop > require-tests. Add others as needed.

PreToolUse.// description: Block rm -rf, git push --force, DROP TABLE, etc.
Block edits to protected directories (src/core/, .env, etc.)

PostToolUse.// description: Run linter on every file edit
Run formatter on every file edit

Stop.// description: HIGHEST IMPACT: Agent cannot stop until tests pass
Agent cannot stop until lint is clean
